title: dzkit sources
description: Every legal text or reference that a rule relies on, and how closely it was checked.

id.description: Stable identifier used by rules and test cases, e.g. loi-21-16. Never reused for another text.

kind.description: One of the kinds in hierarchy.yaml.

number.description: Official number of the text, e.g. 21-16.

date.description: Date the text was signed or issued.

jo.description: Journal officiel issue. Links to the PDFs on joradp.dz are generated from it.

url.description: Where the source can be read, when it is not (only) in the Journal officiel.

quote.description: Short extract of the relevant passage, so anyone can check it quickly.

amends.description: Ids of sources this text amends.

verification.description: How closely this source was checked.

read.description: original: the source itself was read in its authoritative form (the Journal officiel PDF, the regulator's own page, the article itself). copy: a faithful copy of the text hosted elsewhere was read. report: only reports about the text were read (press, guides).

via.description: Pages through which the source was read, when read is copy or report.

access.description: Where the url can be opened from. 'algeria-only': the site refuses connections from outside Algeria, so the weekly link check (which runs abroad) can't reach it; it is checked by hand from Algeria instead.
